It also says readiness probes depend on both Redis and database connectivity. The payment error runbook (E2) adds that a PAY-503 payment unavailability condition should be investigated via the payment service health endpoint, deployment events and error-rate metrics, downstream gateway availability and connection-pool saturation, and log correlation by request ID. The payment API troubleshooting runbook (E5) likewise lists upstream timeouts, PostgreSQL connection pool saturation, recent deployment changes, and database connectivity verification. So Redis reachability alone is insufficient; application-level session cache lookups, readiness, and downstream/database dependencies must also be confirmed. The evidence does not provide specific ping command syntax, thresholds, or a definitive pass/fail criterion beyond these checks.
